# Lalit Enterprises

> Lalit Enterprises is an authorised Xuping Jewellery wholesale agent based in Chennai, India, supplying bulk imitation (fashion) jewellery — anti-tarnish, gold-plated, non-allergic, everyday-wear designs — to resellers, boutique owners, and retailers across India since 2002.

Wholesale-only (B2B). Not a retail storefront for individual consumers. Orders are placed via WhatsApp, a free 1-on-1 video call consultation, or the website's enquiry/appointment forms, subject to a minimum order quantity and minimum order value.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://lalitenterprise.in/): Overview, featured collections, FAQs
- [Products](https://lalitenterprise.in/products/): Full catalogue, searchable and filterable by collection
- [About](https://lalitenterprise.in/about/): Company history, why resellers choose us, reseller testimonials
- [Contact](https://lalitenterprise.in/contact/): Enquiry form, appointment request, WhatsApp/phone/Instagram
- [Book a Video Call](https://lalitenterprise.in/video-call/): Free live consultation to view actual pieces before ordering
- [Blog](https://lalitenterprise.in/blogs/): Guides on imitation jewellery, Xuping sourcing, and wholesale buying
- [Terms of Service](https://lalitenterprise.in/terms/): MOQ/MOV, payment, and dispatch policy
